shortDescription: Gather infos about Hetzner Storage Box Types.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Storage Box Type to get. If the ID is invalid, the module will fail.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Storage Box Type to get.
